subject.title: feat(xiaomi): expose MiMo V2.5 on pay-as-you-go and default to mimo-v2.5

question: Should OpenClaw change Xiaomi PAYG and token-plan fresh onboarding defaults to `mimo-v2.5`, or narrow this PR to catalog availability while preserving existing defaults?
rationale: The catalog rows are straightforward, but default provider routing affects fresh setups and belongs to maintainer product/provider policy rather than automated review judgment.

options.title: Approve V2.5 Defaults
options.body: Merge the catalog update with `mimo-v2.5` as the fresh default for both Xiaomi providers after conflict resolution and final checks.

options.title: Catalog Only
options.body: Keep the V2.5 catalog/docs/tests but preserve the existing PAYG and token-plan defaults until a separate default-change decision is made.

options.title: Pause for Canonical Routing Work
options.body: Hold or close this PR in favor of the broader #87277 multimodal routing and Xiaomi model strategy if maintainers want one combined decision.

recommendation.title: Approve V2.5 Defaults
recommendation.body: Merge the catalog update with `mimo-v2.5` as the fresh default for both Xiaomi providers after conflict resolution and final checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent Xiaomi token-plan V2.5 provider surface and are the strongest history match for Xiaomi default-model policy.
